Summary of the BLAST hits of each sequence

Source: R/blast_hits.R
blast_summary.Rd

One row per sequence of a long parallel_blast() result (or of as_blast_long()): Check ID and the other summary columns described in check_hits(), and Best low qcov (the best hit covers less of the query than perc_qcov_hsp: the identification rests on a partial alignment). Sequences without hits have N hits = 0 and NA elsewhere.

The long results keep only the first num_alignments hits and the ones tied with the best, but N hits, N taxids and N uninformative count all the subjects BLAST returned (up to search_alignments), as do N hits same taxid as 1st and Best uninformative score when rank_by is the one of the search: parallel_blast() keeps these counts in the attribute BLASTr_metadata (hit_counts). For sequences without them (results of older versions, other tables) they are computed from the rows of x. So N hits equal to search_alignments means BLAST returned as many subjects as it was asked for: the list may have been cut.

Usage

blast_summary(
  x,
  check_n = NULL,
  tolerance = NULL,
  rank_by = NULL,
  search_alignments = NULL
)

Arguments

x

Long BLASTr results.

check_n, tolerance, rank_by, search_alignments

As in check_hits(). NULL (default) uses the values of the search, kept in the attribute BLASTr_metadata, or else 10, 0.5, "similarity" and NA.

Value

A tibble with Sequence and the summary columns.

See also

Other result functions: as_blast_long(), blast_lca(), check_hits(), similarity_score(), uninformative_references()

Examples

# hits of two sequences: the first one tied between Homo and Pan
wide <- data.frame(
  Sequence = c("ACGT", "TTGA"),
  `1_subject` = c("A1", "B1"), `1_identity` = c(100, 99), `1_qcovhsp` = 100,
  `1_staxid` = "9606",
  `2_subject` = c("A2", "B2"), `2_identity` = c(99.8, 90), `2_qcovhsp` = 100,
  `2_staxid` = "9598",
  check.names = FALSE
)
hits <- as_blast_long(wide)
blast_summary(hits)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 12
#>   Sequence `Check ID` `N hits` `N taxids` `N hits same taxid as 1st`
#>   <chr>    <chr>         <int>      <int>                      <int>
#> 1 ACGT     check ID          2          2                          1
#> 2 TTGA     best ID           2          2                          1
#> # ℹ 7 more variables: `N hits at best` <int>, `N taxids at best` <int>,
#> #   `Taxids at best` <chr>, `At best truncated` <lgl>, `N uninformative` <int>,
#> #   `Best uninformative score` <dbl>, `Best low qcov` <lgl>

# needs BLAST+ (see install_dependencies())
if (has_blast()) {
  fasta <- system.file("extdata", "minimal_db_blast.fasta", package = "BLASTr")
  db <- file.path(tempdir(), "minimal_db_blast")
  make_blast_db(fasta, db_path = db)
  seqs <- readLines(system.file("extdata", "seqs_test.txt", package = "BLASTr"))
  res <- parallel_blast(seqs, db)
  blast_summary(res)
}
